notes.title: New Drop Pool is now Live!
notes.content:
New drop pool changes are now live with more Waifus to collect to your journey!

The new waifu drop pool is now live and will replace the previous drop pool. We have been busy, but more frequent drop changes and updates will be coming!

notes.title: New Drop Pool is now Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/890400f85f7e7bd3361969cd77b8f0b880800cb0.png

New drop pool changes are now live and December drop pool has been closed!

Hope everyone had a good New Year! The new waifu drop pool is now live and will replace the previous drop pool. 

New WEEB patch should be coming soon as well that will bring bug fixes, new features and more! Stay tuned for that in the upcoming announcements.

notes.title: New Years Extremely Rare Waifu Drop Now Live!
notes.content:
During New Years Eve, there is a small chance to gain something rare!

The New Year Celebration Waifu will drop only during December 31st and it is intended to be rare. The drop chance for the Waifu will be 15% every 3 hours of playtime.

Happy New Year! More updates coming early next year!

notes.title: Weebsgiving has concluded! New Winter Season drop pool live now!
notes.content:
Weebsgiving has now concluded and the Waifus from the event will no longer drop!

With this comes the Winter Season drops! 4 new Waifus to collect along with the very rare Reindeer Waifu!

We have more plans for the month of December, so keep an eye on the announcements!

notes.title: WEEB Major Update #1
notes.content:
You can now progress your clicks in the form of click power and Hearts per second. Upgrade your clicks, find unlockable skins and find more Waifus!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/3327449b1e211ed6a7dadd264713b0bdbbe48130.jpg


 Update Summary
 Added more unlockable skins!
 Click progression.
 Updates to clicks.
 Automated "Hearts per second" upgrades.
 Secret unlockable skins.
 More places to visit.

We are thinking about expanding the inventory system where each Waifu will have defined stats to click powers. Stay tuned for more information about that in the near future!

notes.title: Weebsgiving is starting! New drop pool! New Waifus!
notes.content:
Weebsgiving is almost here and the Waifus have been making preparations for a feast!

New drop pool changes are coming with Weebsgiving! All the Waifus from the Halloween event have been removed from the drop pool! There are 4 new Waifus to add to your collection from the Weebsgiving event, including a very rare Tribal Waifu! 

Can you collect them all before the event ends on November 30th?

notes.title: Waifuween is here! New drop pool changes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/d7e540142a8cdb662a7668314e3abe1f38eb03e3.png

With Waifuween, changes have been done to the Waifu drop pool!

New drop pool changes are here just in time for the spooky season! The new waifus can be just as cute as they are scary. There are 4 new and unique waifus waiting to join your party. Maybe you can show them the spirit of Waifuween?

notes.title: Drop Pool Changes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/0a42b329fc1f9350b3e5fc18d4f7cc746240ee46.png

Changes have been done to the Waifu drop pool!

New drop pool changes towards the fall season will include many new Waifus. Keep an eye out for the legendary Elementalist Waifu! 

We have more planned as we are moving towards the spooky season.

notes.title: New Waifu Drop Pool Changes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/695cd0c1e128ea12052a6352eeed75b2c89d581b.png

Medieval Waifu Tournament is Over!

The Medieval Waifu Tournament Event has now concluded! With that comes new changes to Waifu Drop pool. There are 4 new Waifu's that are waiting to join the journey!

We have planned new features towards WEEB soon, and can't wait to show more in the future!

notes.title: Medieval Waifu Tournament Event Begins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068171/a0dd36063444b2879c099ae1d0dd38927a129982.png

Welcome to the Medieval Waifu Tournament!

The Medieval Waifu Tournament is a week long event where you will be able to find unique new drops to your Waifu collection!

Kiyomi will also be attending the event and has changed her outfit to better fit the medieval theme. Guide her on her journey to reach the throne room!

With the addition of the Medieval Waifu tournament drops, "Soccer Waifu", "Track Runner Waifu" and "Basketball Waifu" will not drop anymore.
